title: Harvest hikes bills by 1500% after acquisition by Bending Spoons
summary: Harvest, a popular invoicing and timesheet tracking software, has increased its prices by up to 1500% following its acquisition by Italian tech company Bending Spoons. Customers, including UK consultancy firm Salentis, report significant bill hikes, with one user's monthly fee rising from $130 to $2,110. The new usage-based pricing model charges businesses based on active projects, clients, tasks, and invoiced revenue, leading to criticism for lack of transparency and corporate greed. Bending Spoons, known for acquiring tech firms and raising prices, has faced similar backlash with other acquisitions like Evernote, WeTransfer, and Vimeo.
